name: extract-structure
description: Read a Markdown, LaTeX, or PDF paper in depth, or explain how a codebase is organized. Use when asked for a structural walkthrough, diagram, or interactive HTML overview.

name: maintain-base
description: Maintain the shared launchers and infrastructure of a research project. Use for command dispatch, cross-component wiring, resource selection, checkpoints, and shared result I/O.

name: maintain-code
description: Review, fix, or refactor research code and its callers. Trace a normal invocation through its dependencies and verify that it still delivers the requested behavior.

name: maintain-conf
description: Add, remove, or change research configuration parameters. Use for defaults, overrides, compatibility with older configurations, and checking that the consuming code uses the value.

name: maintain-dataset
description: Add, update, or remove a research dataset. Use for dataset registration, loaders, preprocessing, splits, dataset choices, and verifying that a task reads the intended samples.

name: maintain-experiment
description: Run, monitor, recover, or review a research experiment. Use for run recipes, effective configurations, execution records, and results produced by the experiment.

name: maintain-github
description: Compare selected local files with a GitHub repository, prepare a publishable copy, or push approved changes to GitHub. Use for requests to publish, update, or review the selected material.

name: maintain-huggingface
description: Review or maintain Hugging Face datasets and Spaces. Use to check repository or runtime status, download assets, publish selected files, or manage Space settings.

name: maintain-knowledge
description: Save or update a durable note about a lesson, decision, or idea from a conversation. Use when asked to capture knowledge people can read and build on later.

name: maintain-model
description: Add, change, or remove a research model or variant. Use for model configuration, weights, initialization, model interfaces, and compatibility with a task.

name: maintain-optional
description: Maintain standalone research scripts, tests, documentation, and reusable assets. Use for work such as plotting results, verifying a component, or updating a project guide.

name: maintain-project
description: Connect, inspect, maintain, or verify an entire research project. Use for first-time project setup, project-wide repairs, and changes that span several research components.

name: maintain-skill
description: Record or analyze project maintenance conversations, improve maintenance skills, or evaluate how agents apply them. Use when asked to save a maintenance exchange, review its file-placement decisions, or run a skills exam.

name: maintain-task
description: Add, change, or remove a research task such as training or evaluation. Use for task registration, prechecks, dataset and model compatibility, execution, and result interfaces.

name: maintain-tmp
description: Organize or clean up one-off research work. Use for disposable scripts, scratch files, and temporary documents, including deciding where reusable work should live.
